design_detail: Supports a wealth tax in the current economic situation, subject to a fixed time limit; suggests three years.
quote_original: A vagyonadót sok országban és több politikai rendszerben is bevezették már. A jelenlegi gazdasági helyzetben én magam is támogatom.
quote_en: Many countries and political systems have introduced a wealth tax. In the present economic situation I support it myself.
source_title: Támogatja a vagyonadót az RTL Cápája
grading_note: Explicit support for a wealth tax; favours a temporary scheme rather than an indefinite tax.

design_detail: Government proposal for annual wealth tax on wealth above HUF 1bn.

design_detail: Candidate’s Mindenki számít programme proposed 1% annually on wealth above HUF 100m with owner-occupied home and some small businesses excluded.

quote_en: I continue to stand for basic income and a basic pension, progressive income and corporate tax, the wealth tax, and the oligarch tax.

design_detail: Candidate’s programme: 1% annually above HUF 100m; includes multiple real and financial assets with stated exemptions.

grading_note: The document is explicitly identified on its cover as Karácsony’s prime-ministerial candidate programme; its wealth-tax chapter specifies a broad asset base.

design_detail: Endorses wealth tax; his separate 2017 explanation discusses taxation of aggregate net assets.
quote_original: progresszív jövedelemadó, vagyonadó), de ezek szükségességével magam is – a 13. nyugdíj kivételével, amelyről korábban már leírtam, hogy mit gondolok – egyetértettem és egyetértek.
quote_en: Progressive income tax and wealth tax: I agreed and still agree that these were necessary, with the exception of the 13th pension.
source_title: Ez lett volna Botka gazdaság- és társadalompolitikai kiáltványa
grading_note: The quote completes his immediately preceding list, which explicitly names vagyonadó; the same author explains aggregate net wealth in his 23 April 2017 article.

design_detail: As MSZP candidate, proposed a luxury tax on wealth above HUF 100m; the applicable assets, rate and whether annual or one-time were not specified in this interview.
quote_original: A luxusadó kizárólag a százmillió forintnál nagyobb vagyont sújtaná.
quote_en: The luxury tax would apply only to wealth greater than 100 million forints.
source_title: Jobbikosokra és fideszesekre hajt Botka
grading_note: His interview proposes a tax on wealth above a specified threshold and distinguishes it from a general wealth tax. The taxable asset base is not specified; seek the programme or a fuller personal explanation before assuming aggregate net wealth.

design_detail: Supports a wealth tax in Hungary; interview discusses the Tisza wealth-tax proposal.
quote_original: Hungary badly needs a wealth tax, for two reasons
source_title: Orbán’s oligarchs on edge as Hungary poised to launch wealth tax
grading_note: His own words explicitly support a wealth tax; grade B because the quoted endorsement does not specify a design. A November report says he distinguishes support in principle from the design of the specific proposal.

design_detail: At a public roundtable, supported some form of wealth tax while warning of practical and administrative difficulties.
quote_original: A beszélgetés elején mindkét közgazdász leszögezte, hogy szükségesnek tartja a vagyonadó valamilyen formájának bevezetését.
quote_en: At the beginning of the discussion both economists stated that they considered the introduction of some form of wealth tax necessary.
source_title: Pogátsa Zoltán: Magyarország gazdag ország, mégis egyre inkább az dönti el a sorsunkat, hova dobott le a gólya
grading_note: Reported speech explicitly attributes support for some form of wealth tax to both named economists, including Horváth. The report does not establish his endorsement of the entire government bill.

design_detail: Election programme proposes a tax on billion-forint fortunes; inheritance is separately mentioned. Details and recurrence are unspecified.

quote_en: We should introduce a luxury tax on billion-forint fortunes, and on their inheritance.
source_title: Szakmai háttéranyag a 2026-os választási programhoz
grading_note: Party programme itself recommends a tax on existing fortunes, in addition to inheritance. Original PDF page 85 visually checked; it gives no rate or recurrence. The distinct inheritance tax is not the basis for inclusion.

grading_note: The interview report attributes support in principle directly to Oszkó; it also records his concern that the draft needs refinement. The quote is reported speech, not a verbatim statement by him.

design_detail: Called for a wealth tax on politically connected billionaires; the report does not set out the precise base or rate.
quote_original: vessenek ki vagyonadót a politikai hátszéllel gyarapodó milliárdosokra
quote_en: Impose a wealth tax on billionaires who prospered with political backing.
source_title: Orbán Viktort arra emlékeztette az ellenzék, hogy ő és a Fidesz is megszavazta a szankciókat
grading_note: Reported account attributes the named wealth-tax proposal personally to Toroczkai. The available wording does not establish whether the tax is recurring or how individual asset classes would be treated.

design_detail: Reiterates support for the party’s oligarch wealth tax, while objecting to the government’s separate draft and taxation of business capital.
quote_original: a vagyonadó, amely oligarchaadóként valóban szerepel a mi programunkban is, és azt helyesnek tartjuk, hogyha az oligarchaadó.
quote_en: The wealth tax, which is indeed in our programme as an oligarch tax, is something we consider right if it is an oligarch tax.
source_title: Toroczkai László, speech before the agenda, 12 October 2026
publisher: karzat, reproducing National Assembly Web API transcript
grading_note: His own parliamentary speech supports an oligarch wealth tax and criticises the government bill’s treatment of business assets. The preferred tax base is not specified fully enough to infer endorsement of the government bill.

design_detail: Joint article endorses Tisza’s 1% wealth tax above HUF 1bn and recommends broad coverage of assets and anti-avoidance measures.

quote_en: The 1 percent wealth tax on fortunes above 1 billion forints is a welcome step.
source_title: Vagyonadó: nem igaz, hogy nem működhet, de okosan kell csinálni
grading_note: Named co-author of an opinion article explicitly endorsing the specified Hungarian wealth tax and recommending design safeguards.

design_detail: Personally supports a wealth tax on large fortunes; acknowledges the joint opposition platform did not adopt it.
quote_original: Én zöldpárti politikusként a vagyonadóban hiszek.
quote_en: As a green politician, I believe in a wealth tax.
source_title: Kanász-Nagy Máté, az LMP társelnöke: A listaállítás piszkos és belül konfliktusos dolog
grading_note: His own words support wealth taxation of people with very large fortunes. He explicitly calls this his personal view; his separate description of the coalition’s luxury-asset levy is not used to establish support.

design_detail: Supports a progressive wealth tax in principle; seeks revisions to thresholds, valuation and treatment of business assets.
quote_original: A progresszív vagyonadó elvét támogatjuk, de az igazságosságot nemcsak az adókulcsok határozzák meg.
quote_en: We support the principle of a progressive wealth tax, but fairness is determined by more than tax rates.
source_title: A vagyonadó éppen a legkisebb és a legnagyobb érintett vagyonoknál lehet a legkevésbé hatékony
grading_note: Karagich is directly quoted speaking for Blochamps; the company consultation response makes its own institutional position clear. This is qualified support in principle, not unqualified endorsement of the draft.

design_detail: Proposed 1% on wealth above HUF 100 million, covering a broad range of assets, with exceptions for a primary residence and some microbusinesses.
quote_original: Tordai Bence benyújtotta határozati javaslatát a nagy vagyonok megadóztatásáról.
quote_en: Bence Tordai submitted his resolution proposal on taxing large fortunes.
source_title: Megadóztatnák a magyar felső tízezer vagyonát
grading_note: Report identifies him as submitter of a parliamentary resolution asking the government to propose a broad wealth tax; the source describes its base. H/8992 was a resolution, not an enacted tax.

design_detail: Supported Botka’s proposed wealth tax as part of a redistributive programme.
quote_original: Az a kicsivel több, mint 40 ezer ember, akit érintene egy vagyonadó, vállaljon nagyobb részt ebben!
quote_en: The slightly more than 40,000 people who would be affected by a wealth tax should take a greater share in this!
source_title: Lehet sírni, de tényleg észszerű válasz a magyar problémákra, hogy fizessenek a gazdagok
grading_note: Signed opinion explicitly calls Botka’s proposed wealth tax and income tax changes necessary; this was written before his parliamentary career.

design_detail: Government proposal: annual tax on net wealth above HUF 1 billion, at 1% and 1.5% for the highest band.
quote_original: Úgyhogy szeretném, ha támogatnák a vagyonadót
quote_en: I would therefore like you to support the wealth tax.
source_title: Dr. Dicső Viktória: T/930 A vagyonadóról
grading_note: In her party’s lead speech she requested support for T/930 and described its rates and threshold. The parliamentary original is linked by the transcript but returns CAPTCHA.

design_detail: Government proposal: annual tax on net wealth above HUF 1 billion, at 1% and 1.5% for the highest band.
quote_original: A vagyonadó bevezetését vállaltuk a kampány során, és ezen benyújtott javaslat mellett állunk.
quote_en: We committed to introducing a wealth tax during the campaign, and we stand by this submitted proposal.
source_title: Gyuk Zsolt: T/930 A vagyonadóról
grading_note: He defended the specific bill and requested a vote for it; his speech includes a likely numerical slip on the upper rate threshold, so the design is taken from the bill as described by its presenter. The parliamentary original is linked by the transcript but returns CAPTCHA.

design_detail: Government proposal: annual tax on net wealth above HUF 1 billion, at 1% and 1.5% for the highest band.
quote_original: az évente plusz egymillió forintot befizet, ez szerintem nem akkora áldozat.
quote_en: That person pays an additional one million forints a year; I do not think that is such a great sacrifice.
source_title: Dr. Ruszin-Szendi Romulusz: T/930 A vagyonadóról
grading_note: In the T/930 debate he defended the proposed levy on net wealth, using the payment due on a HUF 1.1 billion fortune as an example. The parliamentary original is linked by the transcript but returns CAPTCHA.

design_detail: Government proposal: annual tax on net wealth above HUF 1 billion, at 1% and 1.5% for the highest band.
quote_original: Ezért vezetjük be a vagyonadót.
quote_en: That is why we are introducing the wealth tax.
source_title: Boda Nikoletta: A/868 Hogyan válik igazságossá a közteherviselés?
grading_note: As state secretary she defended the planned annual tax on net wealth, giving its threshold and rates; this was a proposal, not an enacted law. The parliamentary original is linked by the transcript but returns CAPTCHA.

design_detail: Advocates the government proposal for an annual tax on net wealth above HUF 1 billion.
quote_original: Ennek a vállalásunknak a legfontosabb eleme a szupergazdagokat érintő új vagyonadó bevezetése
quote_en: The most important element of this commitment is the introduction of a new wealth tax affecting the super-rich.
source_title: Borsós Gabriella: A/868 Hogyan válik igazságossá a közteherviselés?
grading_note: Her parliamentary question endorses the specified government proposal and argues for its redistributive purpose. The parliamentary original is linked but returns CAPTCHA.

design_detail: Endorsed the government wealth tax for billionaires, discussed in Parliament the preceding day as bill T/930.
quote_original: És valóban, bevezetjük a vagyonadót a milliárdosoknak
quote_en: And indeed, we will introduce the wealth tax for billionaires.
source_title: Bujdosó Andrea Anna: T/927 Egyes adózási tárgyú és más kapcsolódó törvények módosításáról T/931 Egyes törvényeknek a vállalatok adózásával kapcsolatos módosításáról
grading_note: Her speech names the billionaires’ wealth tax discussed the previous day; that debate was on T/930, a broad annual net wealth tax. She also calls it a luxury tax, but the named measure is not limited to luxury assets. The original parliamentary transcript is linked but served CAPTCHA.

design_detail: In response to a question naming Tisza’s wealth-tax plan, supports it in principle while questioning how tax would be paid on illiquid business wealth.
quote_original: Én alapvetően támogatom, de az a kérdés, hogyan oldják meg.
quote_en: I basically support it, but the question is how they will implement it.
source_title: Magyar építőipari milliárdos: interjú Varga Mihállyal
grading_note: The preceding interview question explicitly names the Tisza wealth-tax plan. His support is qualified by concerns about paying tax on ownership of a business; the page identifies him as the KÉSZ founder.

design_detail: Párbeszéd programme proposed an annual 1% wealth tax above HUF 100 million, including financial assets and business holdings, with the primary residence exempt; treatment of debts is not specified here.
quote_original: évi egy százalékos vagyonadót javasolt a vagyonok 100 millió feletti részére.
quote_en: Proposed an annual one-percent wealth tax on wealth above 100 million forints.
source_title: Egyetértünk Mellárral – adózzanak a gazdagok!
grading_note: Party statement presents its own programme and its broad taxable asset base.

design_detail: Proposed a pandemic solidarity contribution based on capital wealth, with 1%, 2% and 3% rates for wealth exceeding HUF 1bn, 10bn and 100bn. Focused on beneficiaries of the political system; the precise taxable asset base, debt treatment, duration and whether thresholds are marginal are not specified.
quote_original: a rezsim legnagyobb haszonélvezői is fizessenek a tőkevagyonuk után hozzájárulást!
quote_en: The greatest beneficiaries of the regime should also pay a contribution on their capital wealth!
source_title: Botka László Nemzeti Szolidaritási Programot hirdetett
grading_note: Botka’s dated and signed proposal specifies wealth thresholds and rates, separately from a levy on companies’ prior public-contract receipts. Neither recurrence nor a complete asset base is established. Review: a 2020 call for a contribution from the regime's greatest beneficiaries; it is aimed at politically connected owners and no recurring tax or full asset base is established.
